title: Avoid the hooves!!
text:
The bad: I’m only giving this a 3 star review because this month we received hooves for the first time. My dog was able to chew off and swallow great big jagged splinters and we hadn’t noticed until she threw them all up the next day. Not good. Immediately threw away all of the hooves. She has had other hooves with no issues. I will continue this subscription but if we keep getting the hooves I have to throw away I may need to cancel.
The good: my dog LOVES this subscription box. As soon as it arrives she gets all excited and opens the box. It’s really cute. She has her favorites and will hold out for them. I really hope we continue to have good experiences and the hoof splinters was just a one off.
label: neutral
